note: Every spoken line in the game. 'text' is spoken and shown as a caption. 'cue' says what the child sees at the same time. {name} is replaced with the player's first name or nickname, {team} with our team's name and {them} with the other team's name. To record a line, save it as public/voices/rich/<id>.mp3 and add the id to public/voices/packs.json.

lines.text: Hello! Let's get you ready for match day.
lines.cue: Your player appears in our kit.

lines.text: First, type your name in the white box. A grown-up can help.
lines.cue: The name box glows.

lines.text: Now tap a colour for your player's skin.
lines.cue: A row of skin colour circles glows.

lines.text: And tap a hair style.
lines.cue: A row of hair styles glows.

lines.text: Now tap a hair colour.
lines.cue: A row of hair colour circles glows.

lines.text: Looking great, {name}! Tap the tick when you're ready.
lines.cue: The tick button glows.

lines.text: This is your team! Tap a player to change her name or her look. You can name both teams, and choose the other team's kit.
lines.cue: Our five players stand in a row with their names. The other team's kit choices are underneath.

lines.text: It's Saturday morning. Hooray, it's game day!
lines.cue: A sunny football pitch with a goal, and a ball flying into the net.

lines.text: The team have a big game today. Coach needs one more player, someone who knows where to stand.
lines.cue: Coach and four team-mates stand on the grass, next to an empty space with a question mark.

lines.text: That's you! First, let's make your player.
lines.cue: The empty space glows yellow.

lines.text: Meet your team-mates! Tap a player to change her name or her look. You can give your team a name too. Tap the tick when you're ready.
lines.cue: Our five players stand in a row with their names, under our team's name.

lines.text: Now, who are you playing today? Give the other team a name, then choose their shirt, their colours, their shorts and their socks. Tap the tick when you're ready.
lines.cue: A player from the other team, with rows of shirts and colours to choose from.

lines.text: Brilliant, {name}! Everyone is ready. Let's go to the pitch!
lines.cue: Your player stands with the whole team and Coach, next to a football.

lines.text: One more thing! After every level there's a bonus question. Get it right, and you win a sticker for your sticker book. Your first sticker will be you!
lines.cue: An open sticker book. Sticker 1 is her own player. The next spaces are empty, with numbers.

lines.text: Let's get your team-mate ready.
lines.cue: Your team-mate appears in our kit.

lines.text: Type her name in the white box, then choose her look. A grown-up can help.
lines.cue: The name box glows.

lines.text: She looks great! Tap the tick when you're ready.
lines.cue: The tick button glows.

lines.text: Hi {name}! It's {round|round one} of the cup. Tap the glowing number on the path to play.
lines.cue: The cup path, with the next moment to play glowing yellow. Further up are the semi-final, the final and the cup.

lines.text: You've moved up the path, {name}! Tap the glowing number to play the next bit of the match.
lines.cue: Her player hops up the path to the next moment, which glows yellow.

lines.text: Play the glowing number first. Then the next one opens.
lines.cue: The moment to play next glows yellow.

lines.text: Tap the yellow button first, to start the next match.
lines.cue: The yellow button at the bottom glows.

lines.text: You won the match! You're through to {round|the semi-final}. Tap the yellow button to play it.
lines.cue: The cup run shows the next round. The yellow Next round button glows.

lines.text: You won the cup! Tap the yellow button to play a new cup, against new teams.
lines.cue: The gold cup sits at the end of the cup run. The yellow New cup button glows.

lines.text: Hi {name}! It's {round|the semi-final}, against {them}. Tap the glowing number on the path to play.
lines.cue: The cup path, with the next moment glowing. The other team's shirt and name are under the top buttons.

lines.text: Your stickers go in your sticker book. Tap the book to see them!
lines.cue: A yellow Tap here pointer shows the book button.

lines.text: Well done! You won the match, so you're through to {round|the next round}!
lines.cue: The cup run, with the round she won ticked in green.

lines.text: It's round one of the cup: kick-offs and goal kicks. Lots of help in this one.
lines.cue: Round 1 is marked, with one ball.

lines.text: It's the semi-final: kick-ins and corners. A bit less help this time. Keep trying, and you'll get there.
lines.cue: The semi-final is marked, with two balls.

lines.text: It's the final! A bit of everything, and the hardest match. No dots this time: you choose exactly where everyone stands. Win it, and we win the cup!
lines.cue: The final is marked, with three balls. The gold cup is next to it.

lines.text: Watch out: in the final, a mistake can give the other team the ball. You can still win!
lines.cue: The three balls glow.

lines.text: We're playing {them}.
lines.cue: The other team's shirt and name.

lines.text: Tap the tick when you're ready.
lines.cue: The tick glows yellow.

lines.text: Let's go! Tap the glowing number on the path.
lines.cue: The cup path starts again at Round 1, with the first moment glowing.

lines.text: We won the final! {team} have won the cup!
lines.cue: The gold cup, with confetti, and the whole team around it.

lines.text: Coach says: you kept trying in every match, and you got better and better. You're cup winners!
lines.cue: The whole team jumps for joy.

lines.text: Tap the tick to go back to the path. You can play the cup again, against new teams.
lines.cue: The tick glows yellow.

lines.text: That's the whistle for half-time. {score|It's one-nil}.
lines.cue: The referee's whistle. Our players get a drink.

lines.text: That's the final whistle. Full time! {final|We won}!
lines.cue: Our players jump for joy.

lines.text: Both teams shake hands. Well played, everyone!
lines.cue: Both teams jump and clap.

lines.text: Peep!
lines.cue: A whistle sound. Not spoken.

lines.text: Thump!
lines.cue: The ball is kicked. A sound, not spoken.

lines.text: Ta-dah!
lines.cue: Two happy rising notes for a good line-up. Not spoken.

lines.text: Ta-ta-ta-daaa!
lines.cue: A short goal fanfare with confetti. Not spoken.

lines.text: Twinkle!
lines.cue: Twinkly notes as a football sticker arrives. Not spoken.

lines.text: Ding-ding!
lines.cue: A warm bell for a right bonus answer. Not spoken.

lines.text: It's match day! We're {team}, in {colours|blue and yellow}.
lines.cue: Our five players stand at the side of the pitch.

lines.text: We're shooting this way, up the pitch.
lines.cue: A big arrow points at their goal.

lines.text: We have the centre kick. The ball sits on the middle spot.
lines.cue: The ball bounces onto the centre mark.

lines.text: The dotted ring is only a helper. You won't see it on a real pitch. It shows five big steps from the ball. That's about five metres.
lines.cue: The dotted ring around the ball glows.

lines.text: Spots! Put our five players where our team stands for our centre kick.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: Tap a player, then tap where she should stand.
lines.cue: A finger taps a player, then a spot.

lines.text: When everyone is on her spot, tap the tick.
lines.cue: The tick button glows.

lines.text: Put all five players on the pitch first.
lines.cue: The players still at the side bounce.

lines.text: The rule says: everyone starts in our own half.
lines.cue: Their half turns red. The player in it has a red ring.

lines.text: The rule says: one of us starts on the ball, on the middle spot.
lines.cue: The ball glows.

lines.text: The rule says: stay five big steps away from the ball until it's kicked. The dotted ring shows how far.
lines.cue: The ring turns red. The player inside it has a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, one player stands on the ball to take the kick.
lines.cue: The ball glows.

lines.text: In our team, a friend stands either side of the ball, close to the halfway line. Then there are two easy passes.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, our back player stands in the middle, on the line of our penalty box or just in front of it.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, our keeper in the orange top goes in our goal.
lines.cue: Our goal glows.

lines.text: In our team, our front player waits five big steps from the ball, in the middle, ready to chase.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, a friend stands either side, further forward than our front player, opposite their players.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: Have another go.
lines.cue: The tick button comes back.

lines.text: Look for the glowing spots. That's where our team stands.
lines.cue: Glowing circles show the empty spots.

lines.text: Let's do one together. Watch.
lines.cue: One player walks to a glowing spot.

lines.text: Now you try the rest.
lines.cue: The glowing spots stay on.

lines.text: Not quite. Have another look, then tap the tick.
lines.cue: The tick button comes back. Nothing else changes.

lines.text: Not quite. Look at the halfway line. Is everyone on the right side?
lines.cue: The players to look at give a little hop. No spots glow yet.

lines.text: Not quite. Look at the ball. Who is going to kick it?
lines.cue: The players to look at give a little hop. No spots glow yet.

lines.text: Not quite. Look at the ball, and think about five big steps. Is anyone too close?
lines.cue: The players to look at give a little hop. No spots glow yet.

lines.text: Not quite. Look at our goal. Who looks after it?
lines.cue: The players to look at give a little hop. No spots glow yet.

lines.text: Not quite. Think about our back player. Where can she help our keeper?
lines.cue: The players to look at give a little hop. No spots glow yet.

lines.text: Not quite. If they win the ball and run, who is ready at the back?
lines.cue: The players to look at give a little hop. No spots glow yet.

lines.text: Not quite. Think about our front player. Where does she wait?
lines.cue: The players to look at give a little hop. No spots glow yet.

lines.text: Not quite. Think about the middle of our half. Who can help there?
lines.cue: The players to look at give a little hop. No spots glow yet.

lines.text: Not quite. Look at the sides of the pitch. Who can our keeper pass to?
lines.cue: The players to look at give a little hop. No spots glow yet.

lines.text: Not quite. Think about our kicker. Who can she pass to?
lines.cue: The players to look at give a little hop. No spots glow yet.

lines.text: Not quite. Think about our kicker. Which friends are ready for a pass?
lines.cue: The players to look at give a little hop. No spots glow yet.

lines.text: Not quite. Think about our friends. What if the ball bounces back out?
lines.cue: The players to look at give a little hop. No spots glow yet.

lines.text: Not quite. Look at their players. Who is between them and our goal?
lines.cue: The players to look at give a little hop. No spots glow yet.

lines.text: Oh! They nipped in and won the ball. Never mind, that's how we learn.
lines.cue: Their nearest player takes the ball a few steps towards our goal. Our players stay where they are.

lines.text: Oh! They got through and had a shot. Phew, it went just wide!
lines.cue: Their player runs at our goal and shoots just past the post.

lines.text: Oh no, they scored. That's OK. Everyone makes mistakes, and we can still win.
lines.cue: Their player runs at our goal and scores. The score changes. No confetti.

lines.text: Heads up, team! Let's get our spots right this time.
lines.cue: Their players and the ball go back. Our players are where she left them, and the tick comes back.

lines.text: Everyone is on her spot. Great work!
lines.cue: Our players do a little jump.

lines.text: You kept trying, and now everyone is on her spot. Great work!
lines.cue: Our players do a little jump.

lines.text: Friends either side, be ready. When the pass comes, step on to it and go.
lines.cue: Our players give a little jump, ready to go.

lines.text: When the ball moves, our front player chases. Everyone else, watch for a pass you can win.
lines.cue: Our players give a little jump, ready to go.

lines.text: Friends out wide, call for the ball, so our keeper can find you.
lines.cue: Our players give a little jump, ready to go.

lines.text: Remember: wait until the ball is kicked. Then GO, and close them down together.
lines.cue: Our players give a little jump, ready to go.

lines.text: Kicker, look for a friend first. Friends, call her name and be ready.
lines.cue: Our players give a little jump, ready to go.

lines.text: Now watch the ball. Try to get to their pass first. If they dribble it in, stay on your feet and tackle.
lines.cue: Our players give a little jump, ready to go.

lines.text: Watch their kicker. If they pass it to the side, be ready to nip in and win it.
lines.cue: Our players give a little jump, ready to go.

lines.text: Look for a short pass. And our friend at the back, stay ready in case they break away.
lines.cue: Our players give a little jump, ready to go.

lines.text: Watch the ball. Stay between their player and our goal, and be first to the ball if it comes near you.
lines.cue: Our players give a little jump, ready to go.

lines.text: Friends on the edge of the box, be ready. Once it's kicked, run in if it bounces out.
lines.cue: Our players give a little jump, ready to go.

lines.text: The ref blows the whistle. Where should the first pass go? Tap where the ball should go.
lines.cue: The two friends, the player behind, the far end and their goal all glow.

lines.text: A pass across to {mate|a friend}. Good thinking!
lines.cue: The ball rolls to the friend.

lines.text: In our team, we pass across to a friend. A long kick gives the ball away.
lines.cue: The ball flies long and the orange team gets it.

lines.text: The rule says: you can't score straight from a centre kick. Try a pass across to a friend.
lines.cue: The ball flies at their goal and a big cross appears.

lines.text: In our team, we don't pass backwards at a centre kick. Pass across to a friend beside you.
lines.cue: The ball goes back towards our goal and a big cross appears.

lines.text: Look for the glowing friends beside you. Tap one of them.
lines.cue: Only the two friends glow.

lines.text: Let's do it together. A pass across to {mate|a friend}.
lines.cue: The ball rolls to a friend.

lines.text: {runner|She} takes the ball forward.
lines.cue: Our player runs up the pitch with the ball.

lines.text: Pass across to {mate|a friend}.
lines.cue: The ball goes across to the other friend.

lines.text: Goal! We were ready, so we could pass and score.
lines.cue: The ball hits the net. Our players jump.

lines.text: Level {levelNo|one} done! Well played, {name}!
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 1 on it spins in.

lines.text: We scored, so the other team restarts the game with a centre kick.
lines.cue: Our goal from level one is remembered. The other team lines up.

lines.text: Here come {them}. Their kicker is on the ball.
lines.cue: Their kicker glows.

lines.text: Spots! Where do we stand when they have the centre kick? Put our five players in our defending shape.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: They kick off.
lines.cue: Their kicker passes to a friend.

lines.text: Our front player closes down straight away.
lines.cue: Our front player runs at the ball.

lines.text: We stay together and defend as a team.
lines.cue: Our players move across together.

lines.text: Their shot goes wide, out over our goal line.
lines.cue: The ball rolls past our goal and off the pitch.

lines.text: That means it's our goal kick! We'll find out about goal kicks in the next level.
lines.cue: Our keeper picks up the ball.

lines.text: Level {levelNo|two} done! Brilliant defending, {name}!
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 2 on it spins in.

lines.text: Bonus question! Get it right to win a sticker for your sticker book.
lines.cue: The medal gets smaller and three pictures appear.

lines.text: At our centre kick, where does our first pass go? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Each one shows our team and an arrow from the ball.

lines.text: A long kick at their goal?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: A pass across to a friend?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: A pass back towards our goal?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! In our team, the first pass goes across to a friend. Then she takes it forward. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. In our team, the first pass goes across to a friend beside you, like this one. Then she takes it forward. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level one.
lines.cue: The pass across glows. The other two pictures fade.

lines.text: When the other team takes the centre kick, where do we stand? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Their kicker is on the ball, with the helper ring round it.

lines.text: One of us right next to the ball?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: One of us in their half?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: All of us in our own half, away from the ball?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! The rule says we all stay in our own half, five big steps from the ball. Then, when they kick it, we chase together to win it back. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. The rule says we all stay in our own half, five big steps from the ball, like this one. Then, when they kick it, we chase together to win it back. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level two.
lines.cue: The right picture glows. The other two pictures fade.

lines.text: Wow! You've won a new sticker! Look, it goes straight into your sticker book.
lines.cue: The new sticker fills the screen, then flies into its numbered space on the album page.

lines.text: And you've now played every moment of the match! Here's a shiny sticker.
lines.cue: A shiny trophy sticker sits next to the medal.

lines.text: This is your sticker album. Get a bonus question right to win a sticker. Tap the arrows to turn the pages.
lines.cue: The album page shows your stickers and the numbered spaces still to fill.

lines.text: When you're ready, tap the arrow to go on.
lines.cue: A hand points at the arrow button and says 'Tap here!'

lines.text: Tap the house to go back to the path.
lines.cue: A hand points at the house button and says 'Tap here!'

lines.text: The rule says: at a goal kick, both teams go back into their own half until the ball is kicked.
lines.cue: Their half turns red. The player in it has a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, our keeper in the orange top takes the goal kick from our goal.
lines.cue: Our goal glows.

lines.text: In our team, a friend goes out wide on each side, near the corners of our penalty box. Spread wide!
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, one friend stands inside, a little to one side of the middle, ready for a pass.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, our front player waits on the other side, just behind the halfway line, ready to go.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, our front player waits just behind the halfway line, in the middle, ready to go.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, a friend waits on each side, in our half, ready to help.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: Their shot went wide, so it's our goal kick. Our keeper will take it.
lines.cue: Our keeper has the ball in front of our goal.

lines.text: The rule says: at a goal kick, both teams go back into their own half until the ball is kicked. So {them} walk back.
lines.cue: Their players walk back over the halfway line, which glows.

lines.text: Spots! Spread wide, find a friend. Put our five players where they go for our goal kick.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: Where should our keeper pass it? Tap a place.
lines.cue: Glowing circles on our friends out wide, and an arrow up the pitch for a long kick.

lines.text: A short pass out wide to {mate|a friend}. Lovely!
lines.cue: The ball rolls out to a friend on the side.

lines.text: A long kick often goes straight to them. In our team, we pass to a friend out wide.
lines.cue: The ball flies up the pitch and their keeper catches it. A red cross shows it didn't work.

lines.text: Look. Our friends out wide are glowing. Tap one.
lines.cue: Only our friends out wide glow.

lines.text: Let's do it together. A short pass out wide to {mate|a friend}.
lines.cue: The ball rolls out to a friend on the side.

lines.text: {runner|Our friend} takes it up the side of the pitch.
lines.cue: Our friend dribbles up the side. Everyone moves up with her.

lines.text: She passes inside to {mate|a friend}. Pass and move!
lines.cue: The ball goes inside to a friend, who passes it forward.

lines.text: {shooter|Our front player} shoots...
lines.cue: Our front player kicks the ball at their goal.

lines.text: Just wide! So close.
lines.cue: The ball rolls past their post and off the pitch.

lines.text: It went out over their goal line, so now it's their goal kick. That's the next level.
lines.cue: Their keeper picks up the ball.

lines.text: Level {levelNo|three} done! Next time we have a goal kick in a real match, remember: spread wide, find a friend.
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 3 on it spins in.

lines.text: Now it's their goal kick. Their keeper has the ball.
lines.cue: Their keeper has the ball in front of their goal.

lines.text: The rule says: at a goal kick, both teams go back into their own half until the ball is kicked.
lines.cue: The halfway line glows.

lines.text: Coach always says: back, wait, GO!
lines.cue: Our players do a little jump.

lines.text: Spots! Back! Put our five players where they wait for their goal kick.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: Wait...
lines.cue: Our players stand still behind the halfway line. Their keeper passes it out wide.

lines.text: GO! The ball has been kicked, so now we can chase it.
lines.cue: Our front player and a friend run at the ball.

lines.text: Our friend wins the ball. Great teamwork!
lines.cue: Our friend takes the ball off their player.

lines.text: Their player knocks it off the side of the pitch.
lines.cue: The ball rolls off the side line.

lines.text: That's a kick-in for us. That's the next level.
lines.cue: The ball sits on the side line.

lines.text: Level {levelNo|four} done! When they have a goal kick on Saturday, remember: back, wait, GO!
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 4 on it spins in.

lines.text: At our goal kick, where do our players go? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Our keeper has the ball in each one.

lines.text: All close to our keeper?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: All far up in their half?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: Spread out wide, with friends to pass to?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! In our team, we spread wide and find a friend. Call for the ball, so our keeper can find you. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. In our team, we spread out wide so our keeper has friends to pass to, like this one. Call for the ball, so she can find you. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level three.
lines.cue: The right picture glows. The other two pictures fade.

lines.text: When they have a goal kick, where do we wait? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Their keeper has the ball in each one.

lines.text: All of us in our own half?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: One of us right next to their keeper?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: Some of us in their half?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! The rule says we all go back into our own half until their goal kick is taken. Then GO, and win it back together. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. The rule says we all go back into our own half until their goal kick is taken, like this one. Then GO, and win it back together. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level four.
lines.cue: The right picture glows. The other two pictures fade.

lines.text: The rule says: at a goal kick, both teams start in their own half. That means us too.
lines.cue: Their half turns red. The player in it has a red ring.

lines.text: The rule says: one of us takes the kick-in, with the ball still on the side line where it went out.
lines.cue: The ball glows.

lines.text: The rule says: stay five big steps away from the ball until it's kicked in. The dotted ring shows how far.
lines.cue: The ring turns red. The player inside it has a red ring.

lines.text: The rule says: one of us takes the corner, with the ball still in the corner of the pitch.
lines.cue: The ball glows.

lines.text: The rule says: stay five big steps away from the ball until the corner is kicked. The dotted ring shows how far.
lines.cue: The ring turns red. The player inside it has a red ring.

lines.text: The rule says: one of us takes the penalty, with the ball on the penalty spot.
lines.cue: The ball glows.

lines.text: The rule says: everyone else waits outside the penalty box, and five big steps from the ball, until it's kicked.
lines.cue: The ring turns red. The player in the wrong place has a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, one player stands on the ball, on the side line, to take the kick-in.
lines.cue: The ball glows.

lines.text: In our team, a friend comes close to the kicker, for an easy short pass.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, another friend stands further away, up the pitch or in the middle, for a longer pass.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, one friend stays back, between the ball and our goal, in case they win it.
lines.cue: The space in front of our penalty box glows.

lines.text: In our team, a friend stands between their player down the line and our goal.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, our front player stands between their player up the line and our goal.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, a friend stands inside, between their middle player and our goal.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, one player stands on the ball, in the corner, to take it.
lines.cue: The ball glows.

lines.text: In our team, a friend comes in close to the near post, for a short pass.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, a friend waits on the edge of their penalty box, ready for a shot.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, one friend stays back near halfway, in case they break away.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, a friend stands by our near post, to help our keeper.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, two friends stand in our penalty box, one on each side, between their players and our goal.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, our front player waits up near halfway, ready to race away.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: In our team, one player stands on the ball, on the penalty spot, to take it.
lines.cue: The ball glows.

lines.text: In our team, two friends wait on the edge of the box, one on each side, ready in case it bounces out.
lines.cue: The players in the wrong place have a red ring.

lines.text: The ball went off the side, so it's our kick-in.
lines.cue: The ball rolls back to the side line.

lines.text: The rule says: put the ball still on the side line where it went out. Then pass it in or dribble it in. No throwing!
lines.cue: The ball does a little hop on the side line.

lines.text: {them} have to stand five big steps away from the ball.
lines.cue: A dotted ring glows round the ball.

lines.text: Spots! Put our five players where they go for our kick-in.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: Where should our kick-in go? Tap a place.
lines.cue: Glowing circles on our friends, and one on their player.

lines.text: A pass to {mate|a friend}. Lovely!
lines.cue: The ball rolls to a friend.

lines.text: Oh! That went straight to them. Look for a friend first.
lines.cue: The ball goes to their player. A red cross shows it didn't work.

lines.text: Look. Our friends are glowing. Tap one.
lines.cue: Only our friends glow.

lines.text: Let's do it together. A short pass to {mate|a friend}.
lines.cue: The ball rolls to the friend nearby.

lines.text: Pass and move! {runner|Our friend} takes it towards their goal.
lines.cue: Our friends pass the ball up the pitch.

lines.text: Shot!
lines.cue: Our friend shoots.

lines.text: Their keeper saves it!
lines.cue: Their keeper catches the ball.

lines.text: Their keeper kicks it long, and they race down the other side.
lines.cue: Their player runs with the ball towards our goal.

lines.text: {defender|Our back player} gets across and makes a great tackle!
lines.cue: Our back player knocks the ball off the side line.

lines.text: It went off the side off us, so now it's their kick-in. That's the next level.
lines.cue: The ball sits on the side line in our half.

lines.text: Level {levelNo|five} done! On Saturday, when the ball goes off the side, look for a friend first.
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 5 on it spins in.

lines.text: Now it's their kick-in, in our half.
lines.cue: Their kicker glows on the side line.

lines.text: The rule says: we stay five big steps away from the ball until it's kicked in. The dotted ring is only a helper, to show how far.
lines.cue: The dotted ring round the ball glows.

lines.text: Spots! Where do we stand when they have a kick-in? Stand between their players and our goal.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: They pass it in.
lines.cue: Their kicker passes to a friend inside.

lines.text: Our friend was ready, so she gets to their pass first and wins it!
lines.cue: Our friend takes the ball.

lines.text: We clear it up the pitch, but they win it back.
lines.cue: The ball goes up the pitch and their player gets it.

lines.text: They pass it forward into our half. Their player runs on to it and shoots...
lines.cue: Their player runs with the ball to the edge of our penalty box and shoots.

lines.text: What a shot! Right into the top corner. Nobody could have stopped that one.
lines.cue: The ball goes into our goal. The score is one each.

lines.text: Heads up, team! We're still a team. Back to our spots.
lines.cue: Our players jump and clap each other.

lines.text: That's the whistle for half-time. {score|It's one each}!
lines.cue: The players walk off for a drink.

lines.text: Level {levelNo|six} done! You defended really well. On Saturday, if a goal goes in against us, heads up and back to our spots.
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 6 on it spins in.

lines.text: At our kick-in, where do our friends stand? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Our kicker has the ball on the side line in each one.

lines.text: All right next to the kicker?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: Spread out, with friends to pass to?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: All far away up the pitch?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! In our team, a friend comes close and a friend goes inside, so there are easy passes. Pass, then move, ready for the next one. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. In our team, a friend comes close and a friend goes inside, like this one, so there are easy passes. Pass, then move, ready for the next one. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level five.
lines.cue: The right picture glows. The other two pictures fade.

lines.text: When they have a kick-in, how close can we stand to the ball? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Their kicker is on the side line, with the helper ring round the ball.

lines.text: Right next to the ball?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: Two of us too close?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: Everyone five big steps away?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! The rule says we stay five big steps away until it's kicked in. Then be quick! Try to get to their pass first, or tackle if they dribble it in. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. The rule says we stay five big steps from the ball until it's kicked in, like this one. Then be quick! Try to get to their pass first, or tackle if they dribble it in. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level six.
lines.cue: The right picture glows. The other two pictures fade.

lines.text: Half-time! Time for a drink and a quick team talk.
lines.cue: Our players gather round and have a drink.

lines.text: Coach says: well done for working so hard. Now say one kind thing to a team-mate.
lines.cue: Our players jump and give each other a high five.

lines.text: It's the second half. {score|It's one each}. {them} kick off.
lines.cue: Their kicker glows on the ball.

lines.text: Spots! Where do we stand for their centre kick? You've done this one before.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: They kick off and pass it to the side.
lines.cue: Their kicker passes to a friend. Our front player closes down.

lines.text: Our friend was ready on that side, so she nips in and wins it!
lines.cue: Our friend takes the ball.

lines.text: We pass it forward together.
lines.cue: Our players run up the pitch and pass to our front player.

lines.text: Their defender blocks our shot, and it goes out over their goal line.
lines.cue: The ball bounces off their defender and rolls past their goal.

lines.text: Their player touched it last, so it's a corner for us! That's the next level.
lines.cue: The ball goes to the corner of the pitch.

lines.text: Level {levelNo|seven} done! On Saturday, listen to Coach at half-time, then go again.
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 7 on it spins in.

lines.text: It's our corner!
lines.cue: The ball rolls into the corner of the pitch.

lines.text: The rule says: put the ball still in the corner. One of us kicks it from there.
lines.cue: The ball does a little hop in the corner.

lines.text: {them} have to stand five big steps away from the ball.
lines.cue: A dotted ring glows round the ball.

lines.text: Spots! Put our five players where they go for our corner. Remember, one friend stays back.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: Where should our corner go? Tap a place.
lines.cue: Glowing circles on our friends, and one on their player.

lines.text: A pass to {mate|a friend}. Lovely!
lines.cue: The ball rolls to a friend.

lines.text: Oh! Their player got there first. Look for a friend.
lines.cue: The ball goes to their player. A red cross shows it didn't work.

lines.text: Look. Our friends are glowing. Tap one.
lines.cue: Only our friends glow.

lines.text: Let's do it together. A short pass to {mate|our friend by the post}.
lines.cue: The ball rolls to the friend near the post.

lines.text: She passes it to {runner|a friend}, who has a clear shot...
lines.cue: Our friends pass the ball to the edge of the box.

lines.text: Ooh! It hits the post!
lines.cue: The ball bounces off the post.

lines.text: It hits the post... and goes in! {score|It's two each}!
lines.cue: The ball hits the post and rolls into the net. Confetti. Only on Difficult, when they scored an extra goal.

lines.text: They kick off and race towards our goal.
lines.cue: Their player runs into our half with the ball.

lines.text: Their keeper grabs it and throws it out. They race towards our goal.
lines.cue: Their player runs with the ball into our half.

lines.text: {defender|Our friend} stayed back, so she was ready. She blocks the shot!
lines.cue: Our friend stops the ball. It rolls out past our goal.

lines.text: It went out over our goal line off us, so it's a corner to them. That's the next level.
lines.cue: The ball sits in the corner by our goal.

lines.text: Level {levelNo|eight} done! On Saturday, keep trying, and keep one friend back.
lines.cue: A gold football medal with an 8 on it spins in.

lines.text: Now it's their corner, by our goal.
lines.cue: Their kicker glows in the corner.

lines.text: The rule says: we stay five big steps away from the ball until it's kicked. The dotted ring is only a helper, to show how far.
lines.cue: The dotted ring round the ball glows.

lines.text: Spots! Where do we stand for their corner? Help our keeper.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: They kick it into our box...
lines.cue: The ball curls in towards our goal.

lines.text: Our keeper catches it! Safe hands.
lines.cue: Our keeper jumps and holds the ball.

lines.text: She rolls it out to {mate|a friend}, quick as a flash.
lines.cue: Our keeper rolls the ball to a friend at the side.

lines.text: A big pass up to {runner|our front player}, who was waiting near halfway.
lines.cue: The ball goes up the pitch to our front player.

lines.text: She races away towards their goal!
lines.cue: Our front player runs with the ball into their penalty box.

lines.text: Oh! She is tripped in their penalty box.
lines.cue: Their player trips our front player. She gets straight back up.

lines.text: The referee blows the whistle. It's a penalty to us! That's the next level.
lines.cue: The ball sits in their penalty box.

lines.text: She runs on and shoots...
lines.cue: Our front player runs into their box and shoots.

lines.text: GOAL! {runner|She} scores on the break! {score|We're winning}!
lines.cue: The ball hits the back of their net. Confetti.

lines.text: Level {levelNo|nine} done! On Saturday, help our keeper at corners, and be ready to run.
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 9 on it spins in.

lines.text: It's the last minute. {score|It's one each}!
lines.cue: The scoreboard glows. One each.

lines.text: She was tripped in their penalty box, so it's a penalty. The ball goes on the penalty spot.
lines.cue: The ball rolls to the penalty spot.

lines.text: The rule says: everyone else waits outside the penalty box, and five big steps from the ball.
lines.cue: A dotted ring glows round the ball.

lines.text: Spots! Put our five players where they go for our penalty.
lines.cue: Our players at the side gently bounce.

lines.text: {runner|Our friend} is ready. Which corner should she shoot at? Tap one.
lines.cue: Glowing circles by both corners of the goal.

lines.text: GOAL! {runner|She} scores! {score|We're winning two-one}!
lines.cue: The ball hits the net. Our players run to hug the scorer.

lines.text: That's the final whistle. Full time! {final|We won two-one}!
lines.cue: Our players jump up and down.

lines.text: Both teams line up and shake hands. Well played, everyone!
lines.cue: Both teams walk to the middle and shake hands.

lines.text: Coach says: I am so proud of you. You listened, you helped each other, and you never stopped trying.
lines.cue: Our players jump and give each other a high five.

lines.text: Both teams clap each other off the pitch. What a game!
lines.cue: Both teams line up in the middle and clap.

lines.text: Coach says: you never gave up, and you kept talking to each other. Brilliant!
lines.cue: Our players do a little jump.

lines.text: Everyone shakes hands, and the families on the side cheer for both teams.
lines.cue: Both teams line up in the middle and shake hands.

lines.text: Coach says: I loved how you helped each other today. Give your team-mate a high five!
lines.cue: Our players do a little jump.

lines.text: Level {levelNo|ten} done, and that's the whole match! On Saturday, shake hands at the end, whatever the score.
lines.cue: A gold football medal with a 10 on it spins in.

lines.text: When they take the centre kick, where does our front player wait? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Their kicker is on the ball, with the helper ring round it.

lines.text: Five big steps away, in the middle?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: Right next to the ball?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: Right back by our goal?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! In our team, our front player waits five big steps from the ball, in the middle. When the ball moves, she chases. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. In our team, our front player waits five big steps from the ball, in the middle, like this one. When the ball moves, she chases. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level seven.
lines.cue: The right picture glows. The other two pictures fade.

lines.text: At our corner, who stays back? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Our player is on the ball in the corner.

lines.text: One friend back near halfway?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: Everyone up by their goal?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: Lots of friends back home?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! In our team, one friend stays back near halfway, in case they break away. Everyone else looks for a short pass. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. In our team, one friend stays back near halfway, like this one, in case they break away. Everyone else looks for a short pass. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level eight.
lines.cue: The right picture glows. The other two pictures fade.

lines.text: At their corner, how close can we stand to the ball? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Their kicker is in the corner, with the dotted ring round the ball.

lines.text: Right next to the ball?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: One of us too close?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: Everyone five big steps away?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! The rule says: stay five big steps away until the corner is kicked. Then watch the ball, and try to get to it first. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. The rule says: stay five big steps away until the corner is kicked, like this one. Then watch the ball, and try to get to it first. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level nine.
lines.cue: The right picture glows. The other two pictures fade.

lines.text: At our penalty, where do our friends wait? Tap the right picture.
lines.cue: Three little pitches. Our player is on the penalty spot, with the dotted ring round the ball.

lines.text: Inside the box, next to the ball?
lines.cue: The first picture glows.

lines.text: Outside the box, five big steps away?
lines.cue: The middle picture glows.

lines.text: By the goal, next to their keeper?
lines.cue: The last picture glows.

lines.text: That's right! The rule says: wait outside the box, and five big steps from the ball, until it's kicked. Then be ready to run in if it bounces out. Well done, {name}!
lines.cue: The right picture has a green edge.

lines.text: Good try. The rule says: wait outside the box, and five big steps from the ball, like this one. Then be ready to run in if it bounces out. You can try for the sticker again next time you play level ten.
lines.cue: The right picture glows. The other two pictures fade.
